// Code generated by @uarp/codegen from spec/openapi.json. DO NOT EDIT.

import { APIResource } from '../../core/resource.js';
import type { RequestOptions } from '../../core/transport.js';
import { pick } from '../../core/util.js';
import type { EventStream } from '../../core/sse.js';

/**
 * Query and header parameters for `streamRunEvents`.
 */
export interface StreamRunEventsParams {
  /**
   * Short-lived SSE token for clients that cannot set headers.
   */
  token?: string;
  'Last-Event-ID'?: string;
}

/**
 * Operations tagged `Runs`.
 */
export class RunsResource extends APIResource {
  /**
   * Stream run events via SSE
   *
   * `GET /runs/{runId}/events`
   *
   * Required scopes: `events:read`.
   *
   * Returns a server-sent event stream; iterate it with `for await`.
   */
  streamRunEvents(runId: string, params?: StreamRunEventsParams, options?: RequestOptions): EventStream {
    return this._client.stream({
      method: 'GET',
      path: `/runs/${encodeURIComponent(String(runId))}/events`,
      query: pick(params, ['token']),
      headers: pick(params, ['Last-Event-ID']),
      options,
    });
  }
}
